dimension_description: This phase-one utility scale is intentionally a proxy: it stores welfare or utility in quality-adjusted life-year equivalents. That makes the values easier to compare with health and time scales, but it is not a universal theory of value. Use it as a pedagogical scaffold for “how much good or bad is this outcome roughly like,” not as a final moral ranking.
